requirements.text: Personalised timetable management should include colour-coding modules, hiding cancelled classes, and adding personal study blocks.
The user interface for personalisation options must be intuitive and straightforward, allowing students to customise their timetables easily.
Automated grade notifications should send timely alerts via email or through the portal when new grades are posted for enrolled modules.
The implementation of automated grade notifications must not create extra load or issues with the existing system.
Structured module feedback system should allow students to submit their thoughts on content quality, delivery, and resources after the teaching period ends.
The feedback submission process must be straightforward, using a simple form, while ensuring anonymity and no interference with grading.
The enhancements must integrate carefully with existing systems, particularly regarding user authentication and data handling, to prevent disruptions.
